correctness.rationale: Four explicit regular differentials form the complete genus-four basis. Standard Cartier coefficient extraction yields block matrices with exact determinant 2a^2(a^5-b^4). On the discriminant complement the Cartier rank/stable rank imply ordinary versus rank-zero. Exact finite-field counts for n=1..4 and the genus-four Weil functional equation yield 1-77T^4+2401T^8; p-adic valuations yield slopes 1/4 and 3/4. Monomial cusp parametrization proves universal counts and motivic classes. The standalone standard-library script reproduces the coefficient identities and point counts; finite checks are not used to justify universal claims.
